messages:
olivia: FYI FinSecure PoC asked for private VPC sizing — 6 week timeline. They expect ~50k inference requests/day, avg prompt+gen ~250 tokens, want 95th <300ms for chat. Need conservative HW recs + GPU-hours estimate.

tomas: do we know model + quant? 13B int8 or larger?

olivia: they plan 13B quantized int8 (open-weights). pref A40 or A100 availability on their infra.

marta: quick back-of-envelope first: total tokens/day = 50,000 * 250 = 12,500,000 tokens. avg tokens/sec = 12.5M / 86400 ≈ 145 tps. peak they quoted is ~180 reqs/min -> 3 rps -> peak tokens/sec = 3 * 250 = 750 tps.

kevin: important: latency SLO drives provision more than avg. If an A40 (13B int8) can sustain ~1500 tps (conservative) and A100 ~3000 tps, then raw throughput suggests: peak 750 tps -> 1 A40 is enough on paper but zero headroom + no redundancy. Recommend 2x A40 for HA and headroom, or 1x A100 if customer prefers single higher-perf GPU.

marta: GPU-hours calc (example for 2x A40 reserved 24/7): GPUs = 2, hours/month ≈ 24*30 = 720 -> GPU-hours = 2 * 720 = 1440 GPU-hours/month. If they want burst pool (1 extra A40) -> +720 GPU-hours.

olivia: can you add a short cost note? FinSecure wants ballpark for procurement.

kevin: rough cost numbers (customer infra-equivalent pricing): A40 op-cost ~ $0.9/hr (varies) -> 1440 * 0.9 ≈ $1,296/month. A100 ~ $2.8/hr -> 1 * 720 * 2.8 ≈ $2,016/month. (these are for estimates only). Also factor power/rack/cooling CAPEX if they buy.

marta: other non-GPU: we recommend 200GB NVMe per node for model cache + sharded kv, at least 25Gbps NIC to avoid network bottlenecks for large batched requests, and a small Redis/LMDB for prefix/KV cache (multi-AZ replication if required).

kevin: autoscaling suggestion: keep a small warm pool (50% of baseline) so cold-starts don't violate 95th. Scale thresholds: GPU util 70% -> add node, cooldown 2m. For private you'll likely use a manual approval policy for adds.

olivia: sample config snippet I'll paste into the procurement doc:

```
node_profile:
  gpu_type: A40
  node_count: 2   # baseline
  warm_pool: 1    # extra for burst
  disk_gb: 200
  nic_gbps: 25
  model_quant: int8
  autoscale:
    add_threshold_gpu_util_pct: 70
    cooldown_seconds: 120
```

tomas: couple of edge considerations:
- KV/prefix cache hit rate assumption matters — if they have many unique prompts, generation tokens won't be reduced. assume 30-40% token reduction with good cache.
- network egress: if they plan cross-region calls or hybrid control-plane, measure expected egress for billing.

kevin: also monitor tail latency reasons: GC, disk/memory pressure, NVLink saturation for multi-GPU models. Recommend Prometheus dashboards with per-GPU tokens/s, kv_hit_ratio, outlier latency percentiles.

oncall-bot: Reminder: open an infra-ticket for on-prem validation checklist -> INC-2024-309 (created).

olivia: action items: (1) I'll draft a 1-page hardware recommendation and include the GPU-hours table + cost estimates, (2) Tomas/Marta please validate the 1500 tps per A40 conservative figure against our internal perf matrix, (3) Kevin to add autoscale warm-pool recommendation and monitoring dashboard widgets. I'll share final doc with FinSecure by EOW. :thumbsup:

marta: I'll run perf tests this week and post numbers here (small script against 13B int8).

kevin: +1. If they expect Q4 seasonal spike (x3), we should recommend procurement for 3x baseline or a hybrid burst plan with cloud fallback.

olivia: noted — will add seasonal multiplier options (1x/2x/3x) and cost delta in the doc. Thanks everyone.
